QuestInfo.name: Pia's Testimony
QuestInfo.0: #p 1012102# says she saw a #rHorny Mushroom#k inside #btown#k. Could it have anything to do with the Puppeteer? Probably! Listen to what #b#p 1012102##k has to say.
QuestInfo.1: #p 1012102# says that she once saw a #rHorny Mushroom#k at #b#m100000202##k in #b#m100000200##k and defeated it. She thought it might have been somebody's pet, since there was only one of them... This sounds like something worth checking out. Go to #b#m100000202##k.
QuestInfo.2: You defeated the #rswarms of Angry Horny Mushrooms#k at #b#m100000202##k. What's going on? Why is the #bpet park#r filled with Horny Mushrooms#k?

0.0: Wait, you really believe me? And that's really what you came to ask me about? You're kind of a freak. But since you're actually talking to me, which is quite refreshing by the way, I suppose I could tell you that I saw a #rHorny Mushroom#k while I was passing by #b#m100000200##k.
0.1: The mushroom saw me, too. It was all #rraging#k and attacked, so of course, I fought back... with my fluffy paws of adorable cuteness!
0.2: I beat the mushroom up real good, then realized afterwards it might be someone's pet, because it was at the #b#m100000202##k. Oops. Maybe I should write a note. So! You going to check it out?
0.3: I wonder if it's really possible to #rtame a Horny Mushroom#k? Remember, I saw the little guy at the #m100000202##k in #b#m100000200#.\r\n#e#b(If you accept, you'll travel to the Pet-Walking Road automatically.)#k#n

no.0: I can't believe I wasted a perfectly good story on you...

1.0: #b(How strange. What are Horny Mushrooms doing at the #m100000202#?)

npc.0: Hey, aren't you supposed to be looking for #rHorny Mushrooms#k at the #m100000202##k in #b#m100000200#?
